slides.title: When should a startup bring in a recruiter?
slides.sub: Not always, and not on day one. Here's how we'd call it.

slides.title: Your first hires often come from your network.
slides.sub: If the founding team can fill the first seats with people they've already built with, do that. Trust is already there, and it costs you nothing.

slides.title: Come with a clear brief.
slides.sub: A recruiter is only as good as the brief. Have these ready, or work them out together.
